newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Turnover on Bahrain bourse slides in the week.
newsitem.headline: Turnover on Bahrain bourse slides in the week.

text.p: Bahrain stock exchange turnover dropped sharply in the week ending on Thursday, with trade focused on the banking and investment sector and the official index losing 3.04 points, official figures showed.
The Bahrain Stock Exchange said the index edged down to 1,614.00 points from 1,617.04 points last week.
Around eight million shares worth 1.6 million dinars ($4.2 million) were traded this week, sharply down from 15.5 million shares worth 3.6 million dinars a week earlier.
The previous week had seen the highest-volume trade so far this year, coupled with a two percent jump in the index.
Shares of 26 of the 39 firms listed in the exchange changed hands in 264 transactions this week.
Bahrain Middle East Bank led the market with more than 2.5 million shares worth 304,738 dinars changing hands. Its share closed on Thursday two fils down to 118 fils each.
Investcorp came next with 327,437 shares worth 222,035 dinars dealt. The bank's shares ended the week at $1.80, up two U.S. cents from last week.
